meta.name: competitor-gap
meta.description: Find keywords a competitor ranks for that the user's site doesn't — the content gap, prioritized by volume and winnability. Use when asked "what does competitor.com rank for", "keyword gap vs X", "steal competitor keywords", or "why do they outrank us".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扒出对手已在排名、你却漏掉的关键词,按价值和胜算排好优先级
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果对手总排在你前面,却不知道他们靠哪些词赢的
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a rival keeps outranking you and you don't know which keywords they own

howto.what: 对比竞争对手排名靠前的关键词与你自己站点的 Search Console 查询,分成缺口、落后、领先三类,按搜索量与相关度排序,输出对照表、前十行动清单,并标出哪些数字是估算、哪些是真实。
howto.when: 当你问“competitor.com 排名哪些关键词”、“和某站的关键词差距”、“为什么他们排在我们前面”等时触发。需要先接入免费的 Ryze MCP 连接器。

say.text: competitor.com 都排哪些关键词?跟我站点做个差距对比
say.note: 会拉取双方关键词,输出缺口表

say.text: 为什么 competitor.com 排在我们前面?哪些词是我们落后的?
say.note: 列出落后词及双方排名位置

say.text: 把他们排名的品牌词单独列出来,当作「vs / alternative」页面候选
say.note: 品牌词会单独成一个候选清单

howto.what_en: Compares your competitor's ranked keywords against your site's Search Console queries, sorts them into Gap, Behind and Ahead buckets by volume and relevance, then outputs comparison tables and a top-10 action list.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask what a competitor ranks for, the keyword gap versus another site, or why they outrank you. Requires the free Ryze MCP connector.

say_en.text: Which keywords does competitor.com rank for? Compare the gap to my site
say_en.note: Pulls both keyword sets, then shows the gap table

say_en.text: Why does competitor.com outrank us? Show the keywords we're behind on
say_en.note: Lists Behind-bucket keywords with both positions

say_en.text: List their branded terms separately as 'vs / alternative' page ideas
say_en.note: Drops branded terms into a separate candidate list
